## Problem

What player or maintenance problem does this solve?

## Change

What is the smallest meaningful summary of the solution?

## Evidence

- [ ] I reviewed every changed line and asset.
- [ ] `bun run check`
- [ ] Relevant tests
- [ ] `bun run build`
- [ ] Desktop browser check, if applicable
- [ ] Touch or narrow-layout check, if applicable

Describe results. Include before-and-after images for visible changes. State which checks were not run and why.

## Risk

What could regress? Consider gameplay feel, controls, networking, saved state, accessibility, performance, and page weight.

## Sources and generated material

List external sources, licenses, and generated code or assets included in this change. Write “None” when there are none.

## Simplicity check

- [ ] This change does not duplicate an existing component, registry, helper, or rule.
- [ ] It contains no placeholder behavior, speculative abstraction, filler copy, tool transcript, or unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Comments explain constraints or reasons instead of narrating the code.
